C1461.title: Electromagnetic Side-Channel Analysis for Digital Forensics
C1461.summary: A 2018 study evaluated electromagnetic side-channel analysis as a digital-forensics technique. The authors argued that, when encryption or access controls obstruct conventional examination, electromagnetic emanations from device computation may expose patterns associated with internal activity. Experimental cases explored the feasibility of collecting and analyzing those signals while noting limitations from device variation, environmental noise, and training data.
